repository.name: agid-postal-kg
repository.purpose: Kyrgyzstan postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: The current Kyrgyz Post new-postal-codes page is an operator directory published 16 October 2025 and updated 28 October 2025. Production assignments require an exact captured table artifact with retrieval time, row identity, branch, code, address context, object type, operator scope, validity, schema, rights and digest pinned. One six-digit code may be associated with multiple rows. The non-numeric mobile-post-office marker is a route or mobile postal object and is never a normalizable postcode. A format match, UPU example, street lookup, place name, coordinate, model or third-party map alone does not create a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The operator directory and UPU sheet provide no official postal coordinate geometry. Do not relabel an administrative boundary, address-register feature, cadastral parcel, post-office point, service route, OSM feature, Voronoi cell, interpolation or machine-learning surface as official Kyrgyz Post postal geometry. A reviewed join may create a versioned derived validation surface only. Official point, route, Polygon or MultiPolygon requires an exact competent-authority artifact explicitly relating the typed postal object and code to geometry with validity, jurisdiction, CRS, topology, licence and digest pinned. Real-time generation remains derived and never fills unknown official coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: The UPU sheet dated 03/2019 documents six digits to the left of the locality and a country-digit, three-digit region and two-digit post-office structure. It shows addressee, premises, street, apartment or door, locality, country and optional province or region, sub-locality and P.O. Box elements. Kyrgyz Post current guidance additionally requires locality, district, region, street, house, apartment and postcode context. Dated examples and formatted strings are parsing and display semantics, not reusable addresses, geometry, building identity, resident identity or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.administrative_rule: The State Agency Address Register and GIS, Open Data Portal administrative classifier and dataset-specific administrative geometry remain independent objects. The public classifier observed is dated and does not state a blanket licence. Code or name equality, containment and temporal overlap may support a versioned derived postal crosswalk but cannot prove current postal assignment, official postal boundary equality or building membership.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic address identity, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building point or footprint geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, branch, street lookup, address-register search, parcel, coordinate, OSM footprint, containment or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: The Cadastre service portal supports property, parcel, street, building and apartment searches and some account-, contract- or fee-mediated services. Portal visibility and a registry, ENI, parcel, owner, person, organization or coordinate result do not create an open national civic-address or building corpus, postal geometry, owner or occupant publication right, or delivery relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: APIs, cached observations and mathematical or machine-learning models may improve search, compress candidate surfaces, detect conflicts and prioritize review. Every output must preserve model and feature version, input digests, observed_at, generated_at, confidence, uncertainty, cache TTL and derived status. It can never overwrite a current operator assignment, manufacture official geometry, infer a house number or building, or silently turn absence into coverage.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Typed postcodes, permitted address points, reviewed derived surfaces, routes and explicitly linked buildings may connect to AGID cells only through versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postal object, administrative unit, civic address, parcel or building as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is official Kyrgyz Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Kyrgyz Post and UPU pages are reference sources unless exact reuse rights are established. State Address Register, Cadastre, Open Data and CAIAG resources require exact artifact-level access and licence terms; portal availability is not a blanket redistribution licence. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every resource, terms version, attribution, access rule, override and digest before promotion. The legacy nsdi.kg hostname is no longer trusted because it currently resolves to an unrelated gambling site and must never be ingested.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact civic addresses, coordinates, entrances, floors, units, rooms, recipients, residents, owners, occupants, parcel rights, accounts, API keys and query logs may expose household, property, security or personal context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Operator assignments, postal-object types, mobile routes, historical assignments, administrative units, names, boundaries, addresses, parcels, buildings, service responses and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store object_type, valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version and supersession independently; never silently rewrite historical evidence or promote cached responses or model output into timeless facts.
